description:
What is Findem:

Findem is the AI platform for talent outcomes. Its Labeling Engine transforms billions of unstructured people data points into verified Success Signals — context about what drives success — and Relationship Signals — insight into how people are connected and where influence flows. Together, these give customers a competitive edge in hiring, executive search, mobility, learning, development and workforce planning. That’s why leaders rely on Findem to improve pipeline quality, reduce costs, and deliver faster, more consistent talent impact. Named one of America’s Most Innovative Companies, Findem is redefining how organizations turn people data into business advantage.

Why We Need You:

Findem is looking for a contract technical recruiter, on-site in Redwood City for four months, to close hard-to-fill roles for our enterprise customers using Findem's AI platform and Claude. 

Findem's recruiting team delivers hires for enterprise customers, and today's searches are new and hard to define: AI, API security, forward-deployed engineering. Hiring managers often sharpen requirements as the search runs. These roles are won through close, ongoing calibration and fast, well-evidenced submittals.

You will work with a pod with two global Findem recruiters. They run search, pipeline building and call scheduling; you own the role breakdown, hiring-manager calibration, candidate evaluation and interviews, and presenting candidates. 

You'll also turn what works into a repeatable playbook for hard-to-fill searches.

lists.content:
Every search follows the same evidence-first workflow, powered by Findem's AI agents and Claude:

  1. Break down the role. Use Findem's AI agents and tools to turn each job description into the tasks the hire must do, ranked by priority. Confirm the ranking with the hiring manager and recalibrate as requirements shift.

  2. Direct the search. Execute the pod's search strategy in Findem and Claude, review the pipeline your global recruiters build, and source directly on the toughest roles.

  3. Evaluate candidates against the tasks. Look for evidence that each candidate has the relevant experience required, not just matching titles or keywords.

  4. Structure the interview. Write questions whose answers confirm demonstrated experience with those tasks: what the candidate did, how, and with what result.

  5. Screen out fraud. Interview every candidate to confirm identity and real experience. Watch for proxy interviewers, answers read from a script or AI tool, and work histories that don't hold up.

  6. Prese

Must Haves:

  • Hands-on Claude experience. You use Claude in your daily work, including Claude Desktop, Claude Skills, the Claude in Chrome extension, and third-party MCP connectors running through Claude.

  • A strong belief that AI can help find the right talent. You're convinced AI helps fill hard-to-fill roles, and you pair it with your own judgment before a candidate reaches a hiring manager.

  • A hard-to-fill track record. You've recruited for hard-to-fill technical roles (such as AI/ML, security or forward-deployed engineering) or senior executive roles, partnering directly with hiring managers.

    • Nice to Haves:

  • Building in Claude. You know how to implement loops in Claude (for example, /loop or scheduled tasks) and have created your own Claude Skills.

  • Global team collaboration. You've worked with an global recruiting team.

  • Advanced sourcing. Deep expertise with GitHub, LinkedIn and Google X-Ray

salaryDescription: Pay is weighted toward results: a monthly base fee plus an uncapped fee of $1,000 for every position your pod closes.

  • Identify manual and repetitive GTM processes and transform them into automated, agent-driven workflows that improve productivity and operational efficiency.

  • Monitor integrations and troub

• Salesforce Advanced Administrator or Platform App Builder certification.

This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping how AI and automation transform Findem's GTM organization. What is Findem:
 
Findem is HR 2.0. We’re a fast-growth startup with an ambitious vision and the technology to back it up. Our People Intelligence platform uses true AI and machine learning to provide critical solutions for talent acquisition and people analytics functions. With the deep insights that our platform provides, companies can build more engaged and diverse teams, and close their talent gaps faster. We have an amazing opportunity to establish ourselves as leaders in this space, and we need strong advocates to help us achieve that goal.
 
We’re backed by top-tier investors including Wing Venture Capital – the same firm that backed Snowflake, Cohesity, and Gong. Findem powers businesses across scaling, pre-IPO, and publicly traded companies who trust us to solve their biggest HR and Talent challenges. We have an incredibly skilled and collaborative team that values curiosity, diversity, openness and building great experiences every day for our customers. Our PM team tends to attract scrappy, collaborative, high-ownership, customer-driven innovators. Emojis, jokes, and pet pictures flow freely in our Slack.
 
Why We Need You:
 
We’re looking for a seasoned Principal Product Manager who can lead one of the most important bets for the company. This role will lead this initiative, including setting strategy / KPIs, driving product choices and delivering high impact. You will be comfortable getting hands-on with detailed, nuanced product choices, while also understanding the larger path ahead with your overall strategy. Finally, to land a great outcome, you will need to be an excellent cross-functional collaborator.

Finance leaders review all key deliverables before they’re finalized, so you’ll have strong support while you own the work.

What you’ll do

Vendor management and accounts payable

lists.content:
• Leading-edge design for agentic and UX experiences across RRA, RaaS, and Exec Search.
  • Agent artifact design and experience — how multi-agent interactions and agent outputs are shaped, presented, and interacted with.
  • Early customer prototype UX and implementation (Exec Search exploratory work).
  • UX design and user workflows for RRA SaaS.
  • Committing UX code polish PRs (front-end polish only — no back-end code or API contracts).

• 5+ years designing and shipping digital products, with a portfolio of live, shipped experiences (not just concepts or handoff mocks).
  • Track record of moving quickly from idea to prototype in ambiguous, early-stage contexts.
  • Preferred: 0-to-1 or exploratory product work, ideally in SaaS or B2B.
  • Preferred: comfort collaborating directly in an engineering codebase and workflow (Git, PRs, design QA).
  • Portfolio and demonstrated ability weighted above formal credentials.
  • Bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

lists.text: What Makes You a Great Fit:
lists.content:
• Strong UX and interaction design fundamentals: user journey mapping, information architecture, and turning complex workflows into simple, intuitive flows.
  • Proven design-systems experience — building and applying reusable components consistently across multiple surfaces.
  • Hands-on front-end proficiency: comfortable committing polish-level PRs in a modern stack (React/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, component libraries), including responsive behavior, empty/loading/error states, motion, and accessibility.
  • Ability to take work from idea to design to working prototype, reusing existing services and APIs rather than building them.
  • Preferred: experience designing for AI-native or agentic products — agent artifacts, streaming outputs, chat/canvas interfaces, human-in-the-loop review, and non-deterministic states.

description:
Job title: IT Recruiter – Emerging AI Roles
Location: Bangalore, India
Work type: Full-time, On-site (US shift)
 

Findem is hiring a Bangalore-based IT Recruiter, working the US shift, to fill the new roles AI is creating for our clients.

About Findem
Findem is the AI-powered talent acquisition platform redefining how leading companies discover, attract and hire talent. Our agentic platform combines enriched 3D data on hundreds of millions of professionals with autonomous agents that do the work of modern talent teams.

Outcome Operations delivers hiring as an outcome: clients buy hires, not seats. Agents do the work that scales; people do the work that doesn’t, like judgment, persuasion, calibration and relationships.

About the role
AI is creating roles such as Forward Deployed Engineer, AI Enablement Specialist and AI Governance, and our clients’ hiring managers are often filling them for the first time. That makes these searches hard. Requirements start vague, they change as the hiring manager learns, and few candidates have done the job before.

You’ll turn that ambiguity into hires. You’ll work directly with US hiring managers to define the ideal candidate, find people whose experience fits even when their title doesn’t, and present a slate every week that gets sharper with each round of feedback. You’ll use Claude and Findem’s agents to move fast; the judgment, relationships and conviction are yours.

Role at a glance

  • Shift: US shift, aligned to US hiring managers’ business hours (evening to early morning IST)

lists.content:
Your week revolves around a standing meeting with each hiring manager, and everything else feeds into the next one.

  • Shape the role with the hiring manager: Work directly with IT Directors, Directors and VPs of Field Services to understand who they picture as the ideal candidate. Help first-time hiring managers separate must-haves from nice-to-haves and pin down the actual work.
  • Adapt as requirements change: Capture each change the hiring manager makes, confirm it with them, and re-aim the search the same week.
  • Map adjacent talent: Few people have held these titles, so identify backgrounds that transfer, such as solutions or implementation engineers for a Forward Deployed Engineer role. Use market data to show hiring managers how many people match their profile, and adjust it with them when the pool is too thin.
  • Run the weekly candidate cadence: Present a new set of candidates to each hiring manager every week. Gather feedback on candidates and interviews, and use recorded meeting notes so nothing is lost.
  • Champion strong candidate

• 4–8 years of IT or technical recruiting, including full-cycle work for US hiring managers (agency, RPO or in-house).
  • A track record of filling hard-to-fill or brand-new roles where candidates don’t fit a standard title.
  • Confidence with Directors and VPs: you can run an intake, ask probing questions and push back with data.
  • Enough AI literacy to discuss roles like Forward Deployed Engineer or AI Governance credibly, and the curiosity to learn the rest fast.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude in your recruiting work, plus strong search skills across sourcing platforms and LinkedIn.
  • Persuasive written and spoken English, and the confidence to sell a role to US candidates by phone.
  • Discipline with notes, follow-ups and pipeline data.
  • Willingness to work the US shift from our Bangalore office.

• Experience with Findem, Glider, or similar sourcing and assessment platforms.
  • Recruiting for solutions engineering, professional services or field services teams.
  • Agency or RPO experience managing several clients alongside their internal recruiters.
  • Experience designing structured interview or screening questions.

• Recruit for the jobs AI is creating, and build expertise few recruiters have yet.
  • Work AI-first every day with Claude, Findem’s agentic platform and Glider.
  • Partner directly with senior US technology leaders, not through layers.
  • Join a team that measures its work in hires delivered.
